description: Non-destructive inline notice on the welcome screen (error state only). Surfaces a session-check/OAuth-availability failure above the CTAs without ever blanking the screen; the primary and secondary CTAs remain fully enabled beneath it. Replaces the old silent stock-photo failure.

designSystem.layout: row: icon + message + Retry text button

message.default: Couldn't check your session — you can still sign in below.

visibility: Rendered only when a session/availability check fails; otherwise not mounted

accessibility.colorIndependence: warning color is paired with the alert-circle-outline icon AND the word 'Couldn't' — never color alone
accessibility.label: Couldn't check your session. You can still sign in below.
